verdict.rationale: Together AI documents first-party integration paths for this story. An SDK-integrations page lists frameworks with "dedicated Together support, with first-class clients, helpers, or providers" (docs-51), and a tool "routes coding agents through Together AI with one command and no provider configuration" (docs-48). It also ships agent skills plus a docs MCP server for coding agents (docs-12, docs-30), and documents OpenAI-compatible drop-in via base URL and key (docs-1). Missing for 10: the specific named agent frameworks and coding agents covered by the guides are not visible in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations.
